notes_for_editor: The Forest Lookouts page quotes an NGS station description (1956) for the 70 ft steel tower. Build date (1933 CCC) and removal (1972) come from the same page, with no second source for either. height_m is converted from 70 feet. Two web searches found nothing on Cove Mountain staffing, fires or the current site. The brief's agency (Ouachita National Forest) and removed status are supported. No corrections. Cove Mountain elsewhere (Tennessee, Pennsylvania) shows up in NHLR and FFLOS caches; not this Arkansas site, so not used.
